title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, v1.119.0
author: Maya Chen
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go): unified auth header handling and configurable retry backoff.
- Streaming: consistent ergonomic APIs across languages (async iterators in Python, readable streams in TS, channel-based streaming in Go).
- Parity: alignment of request/response shapes, error codes, and pagination helpers.
- Version bumps: Python v1.119.0, TypeScript v1.119.0, Go v1.119.0.
- Minor docs and example updates.
description:
Motivation: We've accumulated divergent auth/retry and streaming ergonomics across our SDKs which increases maintenance burden and leads to subtle bugs in edge cases (token refresh, transient 5xxs over streamed connections, inconsistent backoff policies). This PR unifies the primitives and aligns usage patterns across Python, TypeScript, and Go so application code and examples are consistent and tests better reflect production behavior.

Summary of changes (high level):
- Introduced common auth middleware behavior: automatic token refresh hook + pluggable AuthProvider interface in each SDK. Default behavior preserves current token caching semantics but adds a boundary for custom providers.
- Reworked retry logic: consolidated retry decision and backoff into a cross-language policy (exponential + jitter, idempotency-aware). Added explicit support for retrying resumable streaming requests on transient failures where safe.
- Streaming ergonomics: Python now exposes async iterators with built-in reconnect/retry hooks; TypeScript exposes ReadableStream + async iterator compatibility; Go exposes a channel-based Reader with context cancellation support.
- Parity fixes: aligned request/response field names for `chat.stream`, `embeddings.create_stream`, and fixed a longstanding mismatch in `listModels` pagination tokens between Go and other SDKs.
- Tests & examples: added integration smoke tests for streaming reconnects (recorded), updated quickstarts and README snippets, and added CI coverage for retry/backoff edge cases.

Commits (high level):
- 7ad3f2c: feat(sdk): add AuthProvider interface and default token refresher (py/ts/go)
- be5c441: refactor(sdk): move retry/backoff into shared policy; add idempotency flags
- d12a9f1: feat(stream): unify streaming APIs across languages and add reconnect tests
- 9c3e4b0: fix(go): pagination token parity + tests
- e4b7f6a: docs: update quickstart and changelogs
- 4f1a2b3: chore: bump versions to v1.119.0 and update changelogs

Files/areas touched (representative):
- sdks/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py (new AuthProvider + refresh hooks)
- sdks/python/redwood_sdk/retries.py (new RetryPolicy + tests/integration/stream_reconnect.py)
- sdks/python/examples/streaming_quickstart.py (updated)
- sdks/typescript/src/auth.ts (mirrors py interface), src/streaming.ts, examples/quickstart.ts
- sdks/go/auth/auth.go, retries/retry.go, streaming/reader.go, examples/quickstart/main.go
- docs/sdk/compat.md, docs/sdk/streaming.md, package.json / setup.cfg / go.mod version bumps

Review conversation (abridged):
- Ethan Rodriguez (reviewer): "Overall looks great. A couple of questions on the retry semantics for non-idempotent streaming requests — are we confident about automatic retries for those?"
- Maya Chen (author): "Reply: we gate retry on a per-endpoint idempotency flag and the streaming reconnect path only retries resumable streams (server-side resume token). For non-resumable streams we fall back to surface an explicit error to the user. Added tests to cover both paths."
- Lena Kim (reviewer): "Please add a small note in the Python docstring about the async iterator behavior when cancelled via context manager."
- Maya: "Done — updated docstrings and examples."
- Tomás Alvarez (approver): "Approved after minor nits; CI green. Recommend squash merge."

CI and gating:
- Initial CI run: some flaky integration tests failed (stream reconnect recording mismatches) — I updated the test harness to stable-record and re-ran.
- Final CI: all checks passing (unit, integration-recorded, lint across SDKs, typecheck for TS, fmt/go vet).

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- Default behavior should be backward compatible for most users. The AuthProvider is an extension point — existing token-based usage continues to work.
- Consumers of streaming APIs should be aware of the new resumable/reconnect semantics: if you rely on server-internal restart behavior, please test with the updated examples.
- Release notes and changelogs updated for each SDK package.

Testing performed:
- Unit tests added for auth refresh, retry backoff, idempotency logic across all SDKs.
- End-to-end recorded tests for streaming reconnects and pagination parity.
- Manual smoke tests of Python async iterators, TS ReadableStream integration in node, and Go example with context cancellation.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Consider extracting a shared canonical spec for SDK behavior to a repo/mono-doc and generate interface stubs.
- Add telemetry hooks for retry counts and streaming reconnects to Redwood Console instrumentation.

Merge: Squash merged into main on 2026-03-01.
notes: Hot path: streaming reconnects and auth refresh were reviewed with runtime team; no performance regressions observed in bench runs.
